verdict.rationale: ADK documents Callbacks that hook into specific events in an agent's execution lifecycle to run custom side-effects, and a graph-based Workflow Runtime with routing, so code-defined rules can trigger actions on internal agent events. However, this requires writing code and covers only agent-lifecycle events, not external or business events. Missing for 10: external event triggers (webhooks, schedules, app events), a declarative or no-code rule definition for event-to-action automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
